name: Service (network abstraction)
description: Stable virtual IP+port for accessing pods. Selects pods by labels. Implementations: kube-proxy iptables/IPVS/eBPF rules on each node. Types: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName.

name: ClusterIP service
description: Default. Allocated from cluster service-cidr. Reachable only from inside cluster. DNS: <name>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local.

name: NodePort service
description: Exposes service on every node's IP at a static port (default 30000-32767). Routes to backend pods (kube-proxy iptables). Useful for bare-metal where no LB available.

name: LoadBalancer service
description: Provisions cloud LB (ELB, Azure LB, GCP LB) via cloud-controller-manager. LB targets NodePort which targets pods. External IP visible in status.loadBalancer.ingress[].

name: ExternalName service
description: DNS CNAME pointing to external host. No proxying. Used to give external service a cluster-internal DNS name.

name: Endpoints / EndpointSlice
description: Lists pod IPs+ports backing a Service. Endpoints (legacy, single object) → EndpointSlice (modern, partitioned for scale). Filtered by pod readiness.

name: kube-proxy iptables mode
description: Default. iptables NAT rules per Service+endpoint. O(N) lookup per packet. Fine up to ~5k services.

name: kube-proxy IPVS mode
description: Hash-table based load balancing in kernel. O(1) lookup. Better at scale (>10k services). LB algorithms: rr, lc, dh, sh, sed, nq.

name: kube-proxy nftables mode
description: Modern (1.29+) replacement for iptables mode. Better performance, cleaner rule structure. Same semantics.

name: eBPF (Cilium-style replacement)
description: Cilium / kpng / Calico eBPF dataplane. Bypass kube-proxy entirely. Faster, supports sockets-level policy, observable via Hubble.

name: Ingress
description: L7 routing rules (HTTP/HTTPS) mapping hostnames + paths to services. Implemented by ingress-controller (nginx-ingress, Traefik, HAProxy, AWS ALB, Istio gateway).

name: Ingress controller
description: Watches Ingress resources, configures the actual L7 proxy. nginx-ingress is most common (ingress-nginx project). Takes the controller's ingressClass annotation.

name: Gateway API
description: Successor to Ingress. More expressive: GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute, TCPRoute, GRPCRoute, ReferenceGrant. Multi-team-ownership friendly. Stable since 1.31.

name: NetworkPolicy
description: Per-namespace, label-selector-based ingress/egress allow rules. CNI plugin must implement (not all do). Default: allow all if no policy applies; deny all if any policy applies + selects pod.

name: CNI (Container Network Interface)
description: Plugin spec for pod networking. Kubelet calls CNI binary on pod create (ADD) and delete (DEL). Plugin sets up veth, IP, routes per cluster's pod CIDR. Major plugins: Calico, Cilium, Flannel, Weave, AWS VPC CNI, Azure CNI.

name: CNI plugin (binary)
description: Located at /opt/cni/bin/. Config at /etc/cni/net.d/*.conflist. Multiple plugins can chain (e.g. main + meta-plugins for bandwidth, port-mapping).

name: Pod CIDR
description: IP range allocated to each node for pod IPs. Set by kube-controller-manager (--allocate-node-cidrs) or by CNI. Cluster-wide CIDR (--cluster-cidr) divided into per-node CIDRs.

name: Service CIDR
description: IP range for ClusterIPs. Configured at kube-apiserver (--service-cluster-ip-range). Distinct from pod CIDR.

name: CoreDNS
description: Default cluster DNS. Runs as Deployment in kube-system. Handles <svc>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local lookups. Configurable via Corefile in coredns ConfigMap.

name: Cluster DNS
description: Pods get /etc/resolv.conf with cluster DNS as nameserver, search list (<ns>.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local), ndots:5 default.

name: DNS policy: ClusterFirst
description: Default. Cluster DNS first, fallback to upstream for non-cluster names.

name: DNS policy: Default
description: Inherit kubelet host's resolv.conf. NOT cluster DNS. Useful when pod doesn't need cluster DNS.

name: DNS policy: None
description: Use spec.dnsConfig field exclusively.

name: DNS search suffix expansion
description: With ndots:5 and search [ns.svc.cluster.local, svc.cluster.local, cluster.local]: any name with <5 dots tried with each suffix first. 'github.com' (1 dot) = 4 cluster lookups before external. The Kubernetes DNS-overhead surprise.

name: Headless Service (clusterIP=None)
description: DNS returns each backing pod's IP directly (vs single VIP). Required for StatefulSet stable per-pod DNS. <pod-name>.<svc-name>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local.

name: sessionAffinity
description: ClientIP = sticky session by source IP. None = round-robin (default). 5xx-tier services don't usually want.

name: externalTrafficPolicy: Local
description: Preserve client source IP. NodePort/LB only routes to pods on SAME node (no cross-node hop, no SNAT). Drops if no local pod. Use with healthCheckNodePort to drain.

name: externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
description: Default. SNATs source IP to node IP, may cross node hop. Even traffic distribution but loses client IP.

name: internalTrafficPolicy: Local
description: In-cluster traffic only routed to pods on SAME node. Useful for node-local caches/agents.

name: Dual-stack networking
description: IPv4+IPv6 simultaneously. Service.spec.ipFamilyPolicy: SingleStack|PreferDualStack|RequireDualStack. ipFamilies: [IPv4, IPv6] order.

name: IngressClass
description: Selects which controller handles an Ingress (matched via Ingress.spec.ingressClassName). Allows multiple ingress controllers in same cluster.

name: TLS termination
description: Ingress.spec.tls[] references a Secret of type kubernetes.io/tls (tls.crt + tls.key). Controller terminates TLS at the proxy.

name: Pod IP allocation
description: Pod IP assigned at scheduling time, persists for pod lifetime. On restart in-place (not eviction), IP keeps. New pod = new IP.

name: Default-deny pattern
description: NetworkPolicy with empty podSelector + no ingress/egress rules = deny all to/from all pods in namespace. The starting point of zero-trust policies.

name: NetworkPolicy podSelector
description: Selects pods to which the policy applies. Empty = all pods in namespace. Combined with namespace selector for cross-namespace rules.

name: NetworkPolicy ingress rule
description: from: list of {podSelector, namespaceSelector, ipBlock}. ports: list of allowed ports.

name: NetworkPolicy egress rule
description: to: list of selectors. Limits where pods can connect outbound.

name: PodIP vs ClusterIP
description: PodIP = ephemeral, per-pod (changes if pod recreated). ClusterIP = stable, per-Service. Use ClusterIP for client connections; never hardcode PodIP.

name: Service DNS name format
description: <svc>.<ns>.svc.<cluster-domain> (default cluster-domain = cluster.local). Search suffixes mean within same ns, just '<svc>' resolves.

name: CoreDNS Corefile
description: Configuration. Plugins: kubernetes (auto-discovery), forward (upstream resolver), cache, reload, errors, health, ready, prometheus, loop. Modify via kubectl edit cm/coredns -n kube-system.

name: kube-proxy --proxy-mode
description: iptables (default), ipvs, nftables (1.29+), kernelspace (Windows). Set via kube-proxy ConfigMap mode field.

name: Cluster network model
description: Each pod has unique cluster-routable IP (no NAT between pods). Each node has cluster-routable IP. Pods on same node communicate without NAT. Implemented by CNI.

name: Cilium
description: eBPF-based CNI + service mesh. Replaces kube-proxy with eBPF dataplane. Hubble for observability. NetworkPolicy with L7 rules (HTTP, gRPC, Kafka).

name: Calico
description: BGP/IP-routing or VXLAN-overlay CNI. Strong NetworkPolicy support. Tigera enterprise tier.

name: Flannel
description: Simple overlay-network CNI. VXLAN backend most common. No NetworkPolicy enforcement (use Calico chained behind).

name: Weave Net
description: Older overlay CNI. Mesh-routing without etcd. Project archived 2024.

name: AWS VPC CNI
description: Each pod gets a real ENI/secondary-IP from VPC. No overlay. AWS-native; pods reach AWS resources directly. Limit per node based on instance type ENIs.

name: Azure CNI
description: Similar to AWS VPC CNI for Azure VNet.

name: GKE VPC-native
description: GKE pod IPs come from a secondary GCP VPC range. Pods routable from VPC.

name: Service mesh (Istio/Linkerd)
description: L7 traffic management via sidecar proxies (Envoy/linkerd-proxy) injected into pods. mTLS, retry, circuit-break, traffic-shift, observability. Out-of-tree but ubiquitous.

name: Cluster Networking concepts doc
description: kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/networking — the canonical 'how does pod networking work' overview.

name: EndpointSlice mirroring
description: Endpoints API auto-mirrored to EndpointSlice. Backwards compat — old controllers still work but get sliced data.

name: EndpointSlice controller
description: Watches Service+Pod, generates per-service EndpointSlice objects. Sliced for scale (instead of one massive Endpoints object).

name: StatefulSet pod DNS
description: With headless Service named <sts>: pod-N.<sts>.<ns>.svc.cluster.local resolves to that pod's IP. Stable identity for clustering apps (Cassandra, Kafka).

name: Pod's resolv.conf search list
description: Generated per-pod: <pod-namespace>.svc.<cluster-domain> svc.<cluster-domain> <cluster-domain>. Plus host's search if dnsPolicy=Default. ndots:5 default expands lookups.

name: Gateway resource (Gateway API)
description: Defines listener (port, protocol, hostname, TLS). Bound by GatewayClass. Routes (HTTPRoute) attach to it.

name: HTTPRoute (Gateway API)
description: L7 routing rules. matches, filters (header rewrite, redirect), backendRefs (services). Attaches to Gateway via parentRefs.
